interaction.text:
The blue dragon snorts at you, his tail flickering in annoyance. His jaw does not move, but the words come anyway, low and rumbling.

"Ash and roses smell the same to the dead. The tower's own fire burns only for those it favours." "A cold hearth, on the night it should have roared, tells truer tales than any warm one ever will."
"Not now," the fighter grunts, not breaking form. "Trying to actually hit the thing today."
The fighter lowers his shield half an inch. "You're not here about the dice game, are you?" He looks you up and down. "I'll guess not. Shame - That empty chair's still bothering half the group."

"Commodore Voss? Used to sit in on our dice nights, regular as anything," the fighter says, not breaking her stance. "That night, he vanished mid-game. Chair sat empty the better part of an hour. Nobody's said where he got to, though."
"If you're not here to spar, you're blocking my light," the fighter says, squaring up against the mannequin again.
The fighter doesn't look up from the mannequin, shield raised. "Training. Alone. On purpose." Back to drills.
